Klasse BaseMessages

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.localisation.BaseMessages
public final class BaseMessages extends Object

Localisation of base-layer messages used across the library.

Provides a central access point to a ResourceBundle with strongly-named message factory methods for common validation and error texts.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, arguments must not be null. Returned messages are never null.

Seit:
1.0.0
